hypothesis.statement: A GPU process can fail after creating partial files, causing an incomplete mesh to be mistaken for a valid reconstruction iteration.
hypothesis.action: Validate immutable RGBA input, benchmark seed and snapshot inventory before execution, isolate backend output, promote one plausible mesh by directory rename and atomically replace candidate metadata only after success.
hypothesis.expectedResult: OOM, interruption, malformed output and retries never expose a generated candidate, while success records exact input, model, seed, snapshot and mesh checksums.

validatedFailures: zero, multiple or implausibly small meshes
decision: Keep the atomic runner boundary. Produce reviewed alpha mattes from canonical 03 and 16 before any real reconstruction invocation.
